description: App 1.8+ serve returns 400 bad_request (details.field, rule) for quote-bearing names or invalid decimal integer literals; typed/radix literals pass through. Creates a user constant in a tag table. Refused with 409 name_collision (details.collidesWith = the colliding tag, constant or block) when the name matches, ignoring case, any tag, constant or block of the PLC. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/constants. M-off.
